problem: The memory worker path lookup used a single-row reader for PRAGMA database_list. Once SQLite reported a temporary schema as well as main, the reader rejected the extra row and returned no path.
observed_effect: The Discord parent/child/return cycle completed, but the lookup logged SQLITE_ROW where SQLITE_DONE was expected and selected synchronous memory preparation. This evidence does not establish memory loss.
change: Select file from pragma_database_list where name is main. Retain an empty path for a genuinely in-memory main database.

cases: All three schemas reported while selected main path remains unchanged
In-memory main database has no reopenable path

logging: Opt-in diagnostics report the SQL statement digest and expected SQLite result code, never SQL text or bound data.
remaining: Production connector rollout and live acceptance
reproduction_detail: The isolated harness initializes delegation schema on the same connection. That migration creates and drops temporary tables, leaving temp visible in database_list. Production provisioning uses a separate process; this record makes no claim that the warning caused measured production latency.
